d:
Jharkhand men mausam ka mijaj badalne vala hai. rajy ke 8 jilon men bhari barish ko lekar alart jari kiya gaya hai. mausam vibhag ke purvanuman ke anusar, 23 navanbar se logon ko barish se rahat milne ki ummid hai. aakhir kin jilon men barish ka khatra hai aur agle kuchh dinon tak kaisa rahega mausam? janie is khas vedar apdet men.
Jharkhand ke mausam ki har bari apdet ke lie vidiyo ko ant tak dekhen.
